notes.title: Morningtide Motel Demo OUT NOW!!!
notes.content:
In case you missed it - Slandercast Studio is back with another game! Morningtide Motel is a narrative-driven motel management game, where you chat with customers, check them into your motel, and learn more about a strange curse that is falling over your country. With so much to do, you find yourself pulling all-nighter after all-nighter, and after weeks of tireless, sleepless nights, you begin wonder… could you even fall asleep if you tried?

The Demo is Available Now!

The full release of Morningtide Motel is coming up soon, and in preparation, we are taking part in this months Steam Next Fest! As such, the demo for Morningtide Motel is now available to play, right on the Morningtide Motel store page! Please consider checking it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3036220/Morningtide_Motel/

As always, thank you so much for playing, and we hope you enjoy Morningtide Motel!

notes.title: Post-Release Hotfix 2: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
Thanks again to everyone who has supported At Winter’s End — we are so grateful to everyone who has played our game, and are excited to bring it to even more of you! We have a handful of small updates for you, and are excited to announce that At Winter’s End is now officially Steam Deck Compatible! Enjoy!

Patch Notes:

 Fixed an issue stopping achievements from unlocking on Mac
 Tweaked input glyphs and tutorials to be more platform-agnostic
 Fixed “Report Issue” button not working on certain devices
 Fixed certain menu behavior to no longer be framerate dependent

notes.title: Post-Release Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for the support, we're really happy to see you all enjoying At Winter's End! The update today is pretty minor, just fixing a couple of small issues we've noticed.

Patch Notes:

 Fixed an issue with Day 3 story branch logic
 Fixed an issue with Day 3 achievement unlocks
 Tweaked colliders in Capybara's Hollow and Pond
